top_band: light/mid green palm canopy crown across rows 1-11
evidence: The palm tree canopy crown is seen from a 3/4 overhead angle (rows 1-11) with fronds radiating out and drooping down, overhanging and shading the top of the segmented trunk (rows 12-39).

style.evidence: The candidate has a uniform 1px pure/near-black outline around the entire silhouette and every frond, giving it a strong 'sticker' look compared to the reference trees which use dark green and dark brown material-toned outlines selectively. Frond and trunk shading is also much simpler and more banded than the rich leaf-clump and bark texture of the references.
